description: This file defines a Java class `LabelMaker` used for creating and rendering text labels in OpenGL ES graphics contexts on Android. It manages label textures by drawing text onto bitmaps, creating textures from them, and rendering labels efficiently using OpenGL draw calls.

classes.name: LabelMaker
classes.description: A utility class for creating and rendering textured text labels in OpenGL ES; manages label textures, adds labels, and handles rendering states.

methods.name: LabelMaker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the label maker with texture size, color mode, and associated parameters.

methods.name: beginAdding
methods.description: Prepares for adding labels by creating a bitmap and canvas.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a label with specified text and paint, optionally with a background drawable.

methods.name: endAdding
methods.description: Finalizes label addition by uploading the bitmap as a texture.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a specific label.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of a specific label.

methods.name: getBaseline
methods.description: Returns the text baseline position for a label.

methods.name: beginDrawing
methods.description: Sets up OpenGL states for rendering labels.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws a specific label at given x, y screen coordinates.
